device.description: 8-bit 150 ns current-output multiplying DAC with unlatched TTL/CMOS inputs
device.note: dac0808.pdf (SNAS539A) p.1 (Dual-In-Line connection diagram, block diagram), p.2 (Small-Outline connection diagram, ordering information), p.3 (absolute maximum ratings: digital inputs -10 to +18 V; electrical characteristics: VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V, tPLH/tPHL 100 ns max, VCC 4.5-5.5 V, VEE -4.5 to -16.5 V)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: no latch: the code is whatever the B1-B8 / A1-A8 inputs hold

commands.name: DATA
commands.note: unlatched logic inputs: the current switches follow the inputs directly

pages: p.1 (DIP connection diagram, block diagram), p.2 (SO connection diagram, ordering), p.3 (absolute maximum ratings, electrical characteristics: logic levels, propagation delay, power supply range)
notModeled: the digital inputs A1-A8 are unlatched (no CS/WR/LDAC): the current switches follow the inputs directly; modeled as a parallel bus with no control pins whose data word is written (and the output updated) as the inputs change
reference amplifier (VREF(+), VREF(-)), compensation, multiplying operation, output current IO and its compliance (all analog)
propagation delay tPLH/tPHL 100 ns max and settling time 150 ns
negative supply VEE (-4.5 to -16.5 V) is in "analog" (the voltage check cannot represent a negative supply)
digital inputs are rated -10 V to +18 V (absolute maximum only); no recommended range above VCC is given, so no inputMax
NC pin 1 (DIP) / 5 (SO): datasheet Note 2 reference on the drawing (no connection)
variants: MC1408P8 is an alternate order number for DAC0808LCN (p.2).
